datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC methodology across Haiti's administrative divisions. The resulting geographic classifications were compiled into monthly near-term projection datasets for 2021, representing modeled food security scenarios based on empirical field assessments.
